By this means, the results Write1 and Write2 are voted by the sender • TheAppDataEl at this stage contains the application data filled in step S10, but the control fields are computed on data filled in Step S0. In case of error (difference) that has not been detected by the sender voter, the receiver serves as the second voter. Only in case of successful voting, the data (application data from second round and control fields from first round) is transmitted through RTE.
